page.overview:
What is Wolf Armor?

The wolf armor is an armor item for tamed wolves. It is a dyable armor that can be is crafted with armadillo scutes.

Wolf armor can be dyed using the cauldron. Similar to dying of leather armor, several colors can be used at once to create various shades.

When wolf armor is dyed, it has the following NBT:
